name: Proving Grounds 22: The Bog Sanctum. A boss arena in a foggy bog, by day (the owner's 30 x 30 swamp arena): a stone road from the south ridge, a slow mud ring round a raised stone sanctum, its altar on the high ground in the middle, two flanking hummocks with high tops, boardwalks over the black water and a wall of dead trees on the cliff behind.
